model_entry.role: main training-scaling model (fits every framework on one GPU)

recipe_semantics.weights: synthetic random initialisation from the local config (no pretrained weights); timing runs seed torch.manual_seed(1234) and build on the device
recipe_semantics.inputs: synthetic token ids uniform over the vocabulary; labels = input_ids (HF shifts internally); no attention mask / padding; 1024 tokens per microbatch, 1023 predicted
recipe_semantics.loss: HF Qwen2ForCausalLM loss = mean token cross-entropy per microbatch (raw objective)
recipe_semantics.backward_normalization: native DDP/FSDP2: (raw / grad_accum).backward(); DeepSpeed: engine.backward(raw) scales by 1/gradient_accumulation_steps internally
recipe_semantics.accumulation: 4 microbatches per logical update (no_sync / set_requires_gradient_sync / DeepSpeed GA)
recipe_semantics.optimizer: torch.optim.AdamW(lr=1e-4) with defaults betas (0.9, 0.999), eps 1e-8, weight_decay 0.01, foreach/fused unset (torch default selection)
recipe_semantics.clipping: none (native: no clip call; DeepSpeed gradient_clipping 0.0)

precision.fsdp: FSDP2 MixedPrecisionPolicy param bf16, reduce fp32, fp32 sharded master
precision.zero1: DeepSpeed bf16 (bf16 params/grads, fp32 master/optimizer, communication fp32, bf16 gradient accumulation)

recipe_semantics.tf32: timing runs set legacy allow_tf32 True (matmul and cuDNN) and cudnn.benchmark True
